sections.Business: Harborview Retail Holdings operates a chain of mid-market apparel stores across the southeastern United States. The company has reduced its store count over the past two fiscal years.
sections.Results: Revenue decreased to 190 million dollars, down from 240 million dollars in the prior year, reflecting weak same-store sales and a goodwill impairment charge of 22 million dollars. Operating margin declined to 3 percent.
sections.Risk Factors: Continued softness in consumer spending could further reduce store traffic.
sections.Liquidity: The company held 40 million dollars in cash and equivalents at year end, after drawing an additional 15 million dollars on its revolving credit facility to fund working capital. Free cash flow was negative for the second consecutive quarter.
sections.Outlook: Management expects results to remain volatile and depends on stabilizing store traffic; a continued downturn in discretionary spending may force further store closures, an outcome that is uncertain and contingent on the holiday shopping season.
